variables.name: capacity_id
variables.note: Trial FTL64, Malaysia West. Env-specific.

variables.name: generator_seed
variables.note: Fixed seed. Changing this invalidates every frozen control total.

variables.name: window_business_days
variables.note: Business days generated and run by usp_run_eod.

variables.name: window_start_date
variables.note: First business day (Mon). Mon-Fri calendar, no public-holiday table (declared simplification).

variables.name: lot_size_mt
variables.note: FCPO contract size - VERIFIED Bursa 2026-09-06.

variables.name: tick_myr_per_mt
variables.note: FCPO minimum price fluctuation - VERIFIED Bursa 2026-09-06.

variables.name: daily_limit_pct
variables.note: FCPO 10% daily limit - VERIFIED Bursa; generator caps settlement moves here.

variables.name: exposure_amber_pct
variables.note: Utilisation band: amber from 75%.

variables.name: exposure_red_pct
variables.note: Utilisation band: red from 90%; breach above 100%.

variables.name: delivery_risk_window_days
variables.note: Open physical commitments delivering within this window count as delivery risk.

variables.name: collateral_haircut_lc
variables.note: LC haircut 10%; cash and bank guarantee 0%.

variables.name: hedge_band_low
variables.note: IFRS 9 dollar-offset / critical-terms band.

variables.name: hedge_regression_months
variables.note: Prospective regression window (synthetic monthly history).

variables.name: unexplained_tolerance_myr
variables.note: FROZEN 2026-09-06 09:49 UTC from the clean replay: MAX(ABS(b6)) over 117 non-engineered days (eng.control_total UNEXPLAINED_TOLERANCE_MYR). Re-freeze if the generator seed or any source table changes.

variables.name: enable_dirty_data
variables.note: Late actualisations out of sequence + one curve restatement. OFF leaves the restatement path untested.

variables.name: warehouse_id
variables.note: WH_PalmDesk item id. Second argument of Sql.Database in the Direct Lake on SQL expression.

variables.name: warehouse_sql_endpoint
variables.note: WH_PalmDesk SQL analytics endpoint. Supplied by the user 2026-09-07; no session channel exposes it (SERVERPROPERTY('ServerName') returns only the workspace GUID). This is the value that unblocked the Direct Lake binding - F-29. Env-specific: a rebuilt Warehouse gets a new one.

variables.name: semantic_model_id
variables.note: SM_PalmDesk. The report's byConnection string resolves this.

variables.name: direct_lake_connector
variables.note: PROVEN 2026-09-07 (F-29): a Fabric WAREHOUSE binds through Direct Lake on SQL. AzureStorage.DataLake (Direct Lake on OneLake) validates on create and never binds a table. Pick the connector from what the SOURCE is.
